derivation: by ext x; apply Subtype.ext; change f.hom ((Rep.norm (Rep.res S.subtype A)).hom x) = (Rep.norm (Rep.res S.subtype B)).hom (f.hom x); simpa using congrArg (fun q => q.hom x) (Rep.norm_comm ((Rep.resFunctor S.subtype).map f)).symm
explanation: `Rep.norm_comm` states naturality of the norm endomorphism for any morphism of finite-group representations. Specializing it to the restricted representations and using the definitions of `quotientNorm` and the quotient functors gives the stated naturality. The theorem’s current proof uses this declaration directly.
